title: What gets TOASTed in Postgres
summary: Explains when TOAST compresses or moves out big Postgres values, and picks LZ4 except for prefix reads and byte slices.

title: Designing Neki for performance
summary: Spares Neki's router from decoding every shard row by keeping Postgres wire bytes and decoding only what a query needs.

title: The lifecycle of a sharded Postgres query
summary: Joins rows split across Postgres shards in Neki's router, whose planner picks hash or nested-loop joins by cost.

title: Concurrency vs. Throughput: why more parallelism can make databases slower
summary: Traces a MySQL meltdown to too many admitted reads walking MVCC chains, then caps the Vitess pool and queues the rest.

title: The feedback loops behind Kubernetes
summary: Stops missed or duplicate events from derailing an operator by letting them only wake a level-triggered reconcile.

title: Zero downtime migrations at petabyte scale
summary: Avoids the write freeze and one-way cutover of dump-and-restore migrations with Vitess MoveTables and query buffering.

title: The State of Online Schema Migrations in MySQL
summary: Picks shadow-table tools for non-blocking MySQL ALTERs, as INPLACE stalls replicas and INSTANT covers few changes.

title: Storing time series data in sharded MySQL to power Query Insights
summary: Stores high-cardinality query-pattern stats, too costly for Prometheus, in sharded MySQL with mergeable DDSketches.

title: Connection pooling in Vitess
summary: Stops ORM SET statements from forcing reserved connections that can exhaust MySQL, with a settings-aware Vitess pool.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 7 - Propagating requests
summary: Resolves conflicting in-flight requests in elections by re-proposing each under a new version and keeping the newest.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 6 - Completing requests
summary: Guarantees acked requests survive and failed ones stay cancelable via a two-phase tentative step MySQL semi-sync lacks.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 5 - Handling races
summary: Settles races between electors with lock-based elections, as a leased leader serves consistent reads with no quorum.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 4 - Establishment and revocation
summary: Avoids errors during rollouts by making revocation its own step, so Vitess PRS demotes the primary as vtgate buffers.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 3 - Use cases
summary: Fits zone and region layouts that majority quorums handle badly by sizing elections to intersect the durability rule.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 2 - Rules of consensus
summary: Escapes majority quorums too big for YouTube's Vitess with single-leader rules that treat durability as abstract.

title: Consensus algorithms at scale: Part 1 - Introduction
summary: Argues Paxos and Raft are too rigid for cloud zones and regions, so the series splits consensus into its concerns.
